content.title: R24 (Residential 24) District
content.summary: The R24 (Residential 24) District is designed for moderate to higher density residential development, allowing up to 24 units per acre. Various residential, hospitality, commercial, and community uses are permitted, with specific classifications indicating whether they are allowed by-right, limited, or conditional, as outlined in the Land Development Code. Notably, single-family detached homes and multiplexes are allowed by-right, while certain uses, such as day care centers and resource extraction, require conditional approval.
content.body:
Intended to allow for new residential development of a variety of moderate to higher density housing products, up to a density of 24 units per acre.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district

| Townhome | L | 3-1-3-2 |
| Multiplex | A | N/A |
| Multifamily | A | N/A |
| Cottages, Micro-Homes, or Co-Housing | C | N/A |
